Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread IMDb’s Denmark release date for Gaza Ghetto as 1998 instead of 1988 and then concluded that Gaza Ghetto (1998) was more recent than Kull the Conqueror (1997). This transcription error led to an incorrect comparison; additionally, the Planner briefly shifted to using the “latest” international release date rather than the widely recognized initial release year, compounding the mistake.
